statement: let C := fun N : ℕ => (Finset.range N).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ N < 3*p ∧ 3*p < 2*N ∧ 1 < N-p ∧ N < (N-p).minFac^5); ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N → Even N → c*(N:ℝ) ≤ ((C N).card:ℝ)*(Real.log (N:ℝ))^2

plain_statement.zh: 对每个充分大偶数 N，中央三分区间的素数 p 中，至少有 cN/(log N)² 个的补数 N−p 没有不超过 N 的五次方根的素因子。
plain_statement.en: For every sufficiently large even N, at least cN/(log N)² central primes p have complement with least prime factor greater than the fifth root of N, for one absolute c>0.

brief.zh: 在 p 与 N−p 同时位于开中央三分区间的条件下筛去 N−p 的小素因子。维数一线性下界筛以略低于平方根的分布水平筛到五次方根，保留绝对正常数。此节点只计粗糙补数。
brief.en: Sieve the complements of primes in the open middle third. A dimension-one lower-bound sieve at a level just below the square root has sieve parameter strictly above two at this cutoff. This node counts all rough complements.
